title: Challenge
description: An instance of standing being exercised: a party listed in a standing register contests a decision, a grant, or a policy. A challenge is how exposure enters the system as an event (Law VII) and what forces a reconsideration.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the challenge conforms to.

register_ref.title: Register reference
register_ref.description: Identifier of the standing register entry that grants the challenger standing.

decision_class.title: Decision class
decision_class.description: The decision class in the register under which the challenge is brought.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether the challenge targets a decision, a grant, or a policy.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Identifier of the decision record, grant, or policy record.

challenger.title: Challenger
challenger.description: Who brought the challenge and on what basis they have standing.

standing_basis.title: Standing basis
standing_basis.description: The exposure that gives the challenger standing.

id.title: Challenger identifier
id.description: Identifier of the challenger, if disclosed.

type.title: Type
type.description: Kind of evidence, matching an admissible_evidence entry in the register.

href.title: Link
href.description: Where the evidence can be retrieved.

responder.title: Responder
responder.description: The accountable person or role who must answer.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: When the responder must answer, computed from the register's response_deadline.

reconsideration_ref.title: Reconsideration reference
reconsideration_ref.description: Identifier of the reconsideration record the challenge triggered.

transition.title: Transition
transition.description: The state transition the challenge produced, matching reconsideration outcomes.
